title: Christmas in Hanley Park
description: A free festive day around the bandstand in Hanley Park, run with the Friends of Hanley Park, with Christmas activities for families.

title: Meet Father Christmas at Trentham
description: Sold out. Children visit Father Christmas in his grotto at Trentham's North Pole, with a photo on the sleigh, a soft toy and reindeer food to take home.
